title: FreeDyn 2.0 model
description: Bodies, joints, forces, measures, drivers, road and solver settings of a FreeDyn 2.0 model (docs/architecture.md). Shapes are for the viewer only.

checks.description: References the results are checked against (freedyn2 check, the viewer, the MCP server); no effect on the simulation. Tolerances are absolute, in the unit of the channel.

mass.description: Total mass of the bodies [kg], e.g. from the weight list.

channel.description: Result channel compared with the curve.

x_channel.description: Result channel of the abscissa (e.g. a wheel travel for a K&C curve). Default t.

file.description: CSV file (relative to the model file), optionally with a header line; lines starting with # are skipped.

x.description: Column (index or header name) of the abscissa. Default 0.

tolerance.description: Largest allowed deviation where the curve and the results overlap.

ground.description: The fixed ground: shapes for the viewer (frame global).

gravity.description: Global gravity acceleration, acting at the centers of mass. Default [0, 0, 0].

parameters.description: Named model parameters, used in force expressions and in formulas: any number of the model may be written as "=expression" of the parameters (e.g. stiffness: =k_susp, position: [0, 0, =h + 0.25]); a parameter may itself be a formula of others (fdgen.formulas).

inputs.description: Named runtime inputs with their default values, used in force expressions and driver motions like parameters. Unlike a parameter, the program that runs the model may change an input between two steps (fd::System::set_input; freedyn2_run --input, --inputs): a rider's steering torque, a throttle, a brake pressure. Inside a step an input is constant. Not allowed in formulas (they are evaluated when the model is generated).

road.description: Road surface of the tires: analytic (fdgen.tire: height = sum of harmonics + slope, friction mu0 with an optional patch) or an OpenCRG file (crg; evaluated by the runtime, fd::Road).

crg.description: OpenCRG file of the road height (relative to the model file): curved reference line, slope, banking.

crg_friction.description: OpenCRG file whose grid values are the friction coefficient (same placement as crg). Default: friction.

position.description: OpenCRG road: translation of the CRG frame in the world [m]. Default [0, 0, 0].

heading.description: OpenCRG road: rotation of the CRG frame about z [rad]. Default 0.
Direction of the wave vector from the x axis [rad]. Default 0.

edge.description: Width of the smooth edges [m]. Default 0.5.

splines.description: Named cubic splines y(x), called like functions in force expressions: name(x).

file.description: Text table with the data instead of x / y (relative to the model file): columns separated by spaces, as the legacy spline data files.

columns.description: file: column indices (from 0) of x and y. Default [0, 1].

type.description: akima (default): Akima, linear beyond the ends; zcc: zero clamped C2 cubic, quadratic beyond the last point (legacy FreeDyn splines).

drivers.description: Prescribed motion: the measure (displacement, distance or angle) follows motion(t), a constraint m(q) - f(t) = 0 (model plugin).

motion.description: Expression of t, parameters and splines, e.g. '0.1 * sin(2 * pi * t)'.

ramp.description: Activation time Ta: for t < Ta a 7th order polynomial from the initial measure value at rest joins the motion C2 at Ta (legacy TimeMotion ActivationPeriod). Default 0: the motion must start at the initial configuration.

measures.description: Named scalar measures of the state used in force expressions.

points.description: Named points (hardpoints), global at t = 0: wherever a point is given (location, point, point1, point2, position) its name may stand instead of the numbers.

frames.description: Named frames, global at t = 0: their name may stand for an orientation (and, in a point field, for the origin).

sensors.description: Points whose motion is written as result channels: acceleration and specific force (a - g, what an accelerometer measures), angular velocity and acceleration, from the accelerations the solver computes (no difference quotients). For motion cueing and sensor models; no effect on the simulation.

point.description: [x, y, z] global at t = 0, or the name of a point (points) or frame (frames: its origin).

orientation.description: Euler parameters, global at t = 0, or the name of a frame (frames).

point_definition.description: A point: [x, y, z] (numbers or =formulas), {mirror: name} (y negated: the other side of a vehicle), {from: name, offset: [dx, dy, dz]} or {in: body or frame, local: [x, y, z]} (in the body frame at t = 0: center of mass, principal axes; or in the axes of a frame from its origin).

in.description: A body or frame: origin, orientation and [x, y, z] directions are then in its frame (a body: center of mass, principal axes at t = 0); point names stay global.

orientation.description: Euler parameters, global. Default [1, 0, 0, 0], or from z (and x).

z.description: Direction of the z axis: [x, y, z] or two point names [from, to].

x.description: Direction the x axis points to (made normal to z): [x, y, z] or two point names. Default the global x axis (y if z is along x).

inertia.description: Principal moments of inertia about the center of mass, body frame.

position.description: Global position of the center of mass. Default [0,0,0].

orientation.description: Principal axes as Euler parameters [theta0, theta1, theta2, theta3], theta0 scalar part. Normalized by the generator. Default [1,0,0,0].

velocity.description: Global velocity of the center of mass. Default [0,0,0].

angular_velocity.description: Angular velocity in GLOBAL components. Default [0,0,0].

shapes.description: Geometry for the viewer (freedyn2 view); no effect on the simulation. Without shapes the viewer draws a box of the body's mass and inertia (a wheel for the body of a tire).

type.description: box: edge lengths size along the shape axes. cylinder: radius and length, axis along the shape z axis. sphere: radius. mesh: an STL or OBJ file (relative to the model file), vertices in shape coordinates, times scale.

scale.description: mesh: factor of the file coordinates, e.g. 0.001 for mm. Default 1.

frame.description: position and orientation global at t = 0 (as all model input, default; e.g. a mesh exported from a CAD assembly: position [0,0,0]) or in the body frame.

position.description: Origin of the shape frame. Default the body frame origin (center of mass).

orientation.description: Shape frame as Euler parameters. Default the body frame.

type.description: spring_damper: line of sight between point1 (body1) and point2 (body2 or ground), s = k (l - l0) + d ldot + f0, tension > 0. force / torque: constant vector on body1. torsion_spring: about the z axis of the frame (orientation) fixed on body2 or the ground, tau = -k (phi - phi0) - d phidot + tau0 on body1. expression_force / expression_torque: magnitude from an expression of t, parameters and measures (compiled into the model plugin), along direction / axis on body1 and opposite on body2.

body2.description: spring_damper, torsion_spring: a body or 'ground'. Default ground.

point1.description: spring_damper: point on body1, global, at t = 0. Default its center of mass.

point2.description: spring_damper: point on body2 / the ground, global, at t = 0. Default its center of mass (the origin for the ground).

point.description: force: point of application, global, at t = 0. Default the center of mass.

vector.description: force / torque: force [N] or torque [N m].

frame.description: force / torque: components of vector in the global frame (fixed direction) or in the body1 frame (turns with the body). Default global.

orientation.description: torsion_spring (axis z) / bushing: frame as Euler parameters, global, at t = 0. Default [1,0,0,0].

stiffness.description: k [N/m] or [N m/rad]; bushing: translational stiffness along the frame axes (number or 3).

damping.description: d [N s/m] or [N m s/rad]; bushing: per frame axis. Default 0.

rot_stiffness.description: bushing: rotational stiffness about the frame axes [N m/rad].

rot_damping.description: bushing: rotational damping [N m s/rad]. Default 0.

location.description: bushing: frame origin, global, at t = 0. Default the center of mass of body1.

tire.description: tire: parameters overriding the defaults: fdgen.tire.TIRE_KEYS (kz, cz, Magic Formula coefficients, ...).

length.description: spring_damper: free length l0. Default the initial distance.

force.description: expression_force: force law, e.g. '-c * y - d * vy + 10 * sin(t)'.

direction.description: expression_force: 'line_of_sight' (default, from point1 to point2) or a vector (global at t = 0; fixed in space or, with frame body, in body1).

axis.description: expression_torque: axis, global at t = 0 (fixed in space or, with frame body, in body1).

body1.description: The body that carries the sensor.

point.description: Position, global, at t = 0. Default the center of mass of body1.

orientation.description: Axes of the sensor frame as Euler parameters, global at t = 0, then fixed in body1. Default [1, 0, 0, 0]: the global axes at t = 0 (e.g. x forward, z up in a vehicle model).

type.description: displacement / velocity: component of P1 - P2 / V1 - V2 in frame; distance: |P1 - P2| and its rate; angle: rotation of body1 about the z axis of orientation fixed on body2 (as torsion_spring) and its rate; direction: component of the global vector in the frame (default body1), e.g. the vertical in a vehicle frame (lean); angular_velocity: component of omega1 - omega2 in frame (global or a body).

point1.description: Point on body1, global, at t = 0. Default its center of mass.

point2.description: Point on body2 or the ground, global, at t = 0. Default its center of mass / the origin.

frame.description: displacement / velocity: 'global' (default) or a body whose frame gives the components.

orientation.description: angle: frame (axis z), global at t = 0.

offset.description: initial: subtract the initial value (displacement, distance, angle); a number: subtract it. Default none.

type.description: Presets fix directions of the joint frame (joint axis z): revolute about z, prismatic and cylindrical along z. generic: the fix list.

orientation.description: Joint frame as Euler parameters, global, at t = 0. Default [1,0,0,0].

fix.description: generic only: fixed translations (d) and rotations (a) along/about the joint axes.

output_step.description: Must be an integer multiple of step. Default: step.

newton.description: velocity: Newton until the velocity change is below newton_tol; fixed: exactly newton_iterations corrections per step (the same work in every step, for real-time use).

form.description: HHT form: arnold_bruls (equations at t_n+1, second order) or negrut (force-weighted, as legacy FreeDyn).
